  • Method Details

    • numarComunitati

      int numarComunitati()
      Counts the communities (connected components of the friendship graph).
      Returns:
      the number of communities; a user without friends is a community of its own

    • comunitati

      List<List<Utilizator>> comunitati()
      Determines the communities (connected components), in the order of their first member.
      Returns:
      the list of communities, each one being the list of its members

    • ceaMaiSociabilaComunitate

      Optional<ComunitateSociabila> ceaMaiSociabilaComunitate()
      Finds the community that contains the longest elementary path (no repeated nodes) between two users. On a tie, the first one found is kept.
      Returns:
      the result, or an empty Optional if there are no users

    • getAvertismenteIncarcare

      List<String> getAvertismenteIncarcare()
      Returns the warnings produced while loading the persistent data (corrupt or inconsistent lines). Calling it makes sure the data is loaded.
      Returns:
      the warnings, each with the file, the line number and the reason; empty if there are none
